```{r, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)
library(dplyr)
library(spatialsample)
library(waywiser)
library(vip)
library(themis)
library(yardstick)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
my_wd_all_dat <- "project_dir"

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(my_wd_all_dat))
```

## Define model of interest

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# runs via 00_run_all
cat("Selected model:", selected_model)
```

## Load data

```{r, include=FALSE}
data_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output_2023/parcels_predictors_06_2023_final.gpkg") 

rf_model <- read_rds(paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_rf_model_", selected_model, ".rds"))

result_classification <- st_read(paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m1_rf_prediction_23_results_", selected_model, ".gpkg"))
```

## Data perparation

```{r, include=FALSE}

dat <- result_classification %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  select(id_par_merge, prob_dens) %>% 
  left_join(data_raw) %>% 
  select(-prob_dens) %>% 
  rename(fa_13 = fa_23)

# remove variables which are not relevant
base_drop <- c(
  "parceltype", "service_quality_chg", "service_quality_2020", "center_quality"
)

nbu_extra_drop <- c(
  "parceltype",
  "share_area_foot_par", "share_floorspace_par", "largest_nonbuiltup", 
  "bldg_flats_sum", "ucp_par", "bldg_age_median", "par_renov_recon", "bldg_type",
  "persons_total_par", "persons_per_fa", "ave_age_par", "only_75_older_par",
  "under_16_present_par", "share_area_par_nbr", "share_floorspace_par_nbr"
)

drop_cols <- if (params$run_id == "nbu") {
  nbu_extra_drop
} else {
  base_drop
}

# drop_cols <- if (selected_model == "nbu") {
#   nbu_extra_drop
# } else {
#   base_drop
# }

data_reg <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(drop_cols)) %>%   # any_of avoids errors if a col is missing
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.factor))

# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(data_reg))

# Remove rows with missing values (if necessary)
data <- na.omit(data_reg) 
```

## Predict on all data 2023

```{r, echo=FALSE}
pred <- predict(rf_model, data)

# Version with relative increase in floor area - log transformed
data_pred <- data %>%
  mutate(
    dif_fa_perc_predicted = exp(pred$.pred),
    fa_13 = if_else(fa_13 == 0, 1, fa_13), # for non-built-up we predict the absolute increase fa - multiplied by 1 it gives the result needed
    dif_fa_absolut_predicted = dif_fa_perc_predicted * fa_13, # convert % increase to absolute floorspace change
  )
```

## Aggregate results

```{r}
results_pred <- data_pred %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(
    sum_fa_predicted = sum(dif_fa_absolut_predicted, na.rm = TRUE),
  )

results_pred
```

## write result

```{r, include=FALSE}
export <- data_raw %>% 
  left_join(result_classification %>% select(id_par_merge, predicted, prob_dens) %>% st_drop_geometry()) %>%
  left_join(data_pred %>% select(id_par_merge, 
                                 dif_fa_perc_predicted,
                                 dif_fa_absolut_predicted)) 

st_write(export, paste0("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/m2_rf_prediction_23_results_", selected_model, ".gpkg"), delete_layer = TRUE)
```
